import { useState, useEffect } from 'react'; import { saveState, loadState } from './db'; export const useAgentMemory = (agentId) => { const [memory, setMemory] = useState(null); useEffect(() => { const sync = async () => { const local = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(agentId)); const remote = await loadState(agentId); const merged = { ...remote, ...local, lastUpdated: Date.now() }; setMemory(merged); }; sync(); }, [agentId]); const updateMemory = async (newData) => { const updated = { ...memory, ...newData }; setMemory(updated); localStorage.setItem(agentId, JSON.stringify(updated)); await saveState(agentId, updated); }; return [memory, updateMemory]; };
